## Passages
RESULT [curation]: 20% training-efficiency gain and up to 2% average improvement on 16 NLP tasks at 6.7B scale. Repeating intelligently selected data beats the baseline, while repeating random data does worse than the baseline.
US [curation]: The incremental loop will re-train on the base set every round, which amounts to repetition. D4's result says what gets repeated should be chosen (deduplicated, diverse) rather than random. A dedup-then-diversify order is also the sensible pipeline order for a new increment.
